biggest_catch: Kraken publishes no official signup or trading promo with a guaranteed payout for Kraken exchange users — the only current official promo is a random-draw trading contest with a single winner, which requires risking your own capital trading SOL and has no guaranteed payout; contests are marketing, not income. The Kraken exchange referral signup-bonus amounts are unpublished by Kraken and vary by campaign (third-party sources conflict: $200, $75, randomized $25-$300).
catches: The Kraken x Solana Trading Contest (Sept 3 – Oct 1, 2026) selects ONE winner by random drawing from all entries — $1 of SOL trade volume = 1 entry, uncapped; winning is not guaranteed regardless of how much you trade.
Entering the contest via trading requires risking your own capital; Kraken Pro trades do not count; a free no-purchase entry method exists via Sweepea, so trading is not required to enter.
No official kraken.com terms page exists for the Kraken exchange refer-a-friend signup bonus — amounts are not published by Kraken and vary by region/campaign; do not trust third-party figures.

The only official referral terms on kraken.com cover Kraken's separate Krak payments app ('$2 USD or more' per qualifying referral, requires Intermediate KYC, $10 fiat funding, and sending funds) — a different product from the Kraken exchange.
The contest excludes Maine, New York, Florida (US), Quebec (Canada), and the UK; void where prohibited.

c1.evidence: Provider is real: kraken.com (Tulip HoldCo Ltd./Payward Inc.); official rules on kraken.com/legal subdomain.

c2.evidence: Official terms exist but only for a random-draw trading contest and for the separate Krak payments-app referral program — neither is a guaranteed signup/trading promo for Kraken exchange users.

c3.evidence: No hidden fee in the contest (free AMOE entry exists); trading entry risks the user's own capital.

c4.evidence: FAIL: No official promo on kraken.com offers a concrete guaranteed payout to a Kraken exchange user. The Solana contest is a single-winner lottery (expected value ~$0 for a typical user); the exchange referral signup bonus amounts are unpublished by Kraken ('varies by campaign' = no concrete claim). The only official referral terms ($2 or more) cover the separate Krak payments app.

eligibility: Contest: legal residents of EEA, US (excluding Maine, New York, Florida), Canada (excluding Quebec), and other jurisdictions where Kraken services are available; UK residents excluded; age of majority; Kraken account in good standing with at least Intermediate KYC.
notes: Checked 2026-09-22 (CDT; pages fetched live). Searched kraken.com and support.kraken.com for a referral-program terms article — none exists for the exchange; the only official referral terms found are for 'Krak' (Kraken's affiliated payments brand): kraken.com/es/krak-referrals-terms ($2 USD or more to both sides; referee must register via referral link, never held a Kraken/Krak account, fund $10 fiat, send funds to others; Intermediate KYC; rewards within 30 days; worldwide minus UK/Singapore/Austria/Turkey and unserved countries). The active exchange promo is the Solana x F1 trading contest: official rules at kraken.com/legal/kraken-solana-tradingcontest-terms (Sept 3, 2026 – Oct 1, 2026): 1 random winner gets ~$10,000 in SOL plus their name on the Atlassian Williams F1 car at the Mexico GP; each $1 SOL trade volume = 1 entry; Kraken Pro trades excluded; free alternative entry via swpp.me; winner notified within 5 business days; prizes over $600 reported to the IRS. No affiliate/review pages were used as evidence; third-party referral-bonus figures ($200/$75/randomized $25-$300) were noted only as conflicting and unusable.
